test_cases.title: Attachment with double extension (allowed + disallowed) is blocked
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the Support Center page; Secure Message form is visible
steps: 1. Enter 'Internet Provider' in Subject and 'Grocery Store - Walmart' in Message Body
2. Select a file with a double-extension filename (e.g., document.pdf.exe)
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is blocked; Attachment control displays inline error that the file type is not allowed; no ticket is created
test_cases.notes: Filled subject with payee name 'Internet Provider' (payee003) and message body with transaction description 'Grocery Store - Walmart' (txn006). Attachment filename used is the example 'document.pdf.exe'. Verification notes: the attachment input is present in the DOM snapshot but its file-selection and server-side validation behavior are dynamic and cannot be fully verified from static DOM.
